prologue.text: DR. NAZŌ, A MYSTERIOUS MAD SCIENTIST, HAS SENT THE ROGUE PLANET ICARUS ON A CRASH COURSE TOWARD EARTH.

CONTRACTED BY THE PEARL RESEARCH INSTITUTE, PROFESSOR MIRE, A RENOWNED FRENCH ARCHEOLOGIST, JOINED BY MARIE MIRE,
AND CREW ARE SEARCHING THE OCEAN BY SHIP FOR THE WHEREABOUTS OF 'THE LOST CONTINENT.'
THIS CONTINENT IS SAID TO CONTAIN A SPECIAL LENS, NECESSARY FOR THE INSTITUTE'S COMPLETION OF THE SUPER DESTRUCTION BEAM CANNON TO DESTROY ICARUS.
[fast]WHILE ON THEIR EXPEDITION, DR. NAZŌ AND HIS MEN ATTACK THE CREW AND THEIR SHIP WITH THE GIANT MECHANICAL ROBOT, FIVE FINGER.[norm]
SHIPWRECKED ON THE ISLAND RUINS OF ATLANTIS, ONLY MARIE MIRE SURVIVES WITH A BOOK CONTAINING THE RESEARCH MATERIALS FROM HER FATHER.
AS THE RUINS ARE BEING OVERRUN BY THE EVIL SCIENTIST, MARIE FLEES AND DISCOVERS A HIDDEN SECRET TUNNEL LEADING STRAIGHT INTO A DARK, ANCIENT TOMB…
LOCATED WITHIN THE TOMB IS A GOLDEN SARCOPHAGUS INSCRIBED WITH STRANGE HIEROGLYPHS.

SURPRISINGLY, MARIE FINDS TRANSLATIONS FROM THE DEPARTED PROFESSOR’S RESEARCH AND BEGINS TO READ ALOUD:

MARIE: [marie1][slow]'EVERY 10,000 YEARS, WHEN GREAT EVIL RETURNS, POUR A DROP OF WATER ON THE SKELETON AND AWAKEN THE GOD OF JUSTICE, GOLDEN BAT.'[norm]
DISTRAUGHT FOR HER LATE FATHER, MARIE APPROACHES THE SARCOPHAGUS WITHIN THE TOMB AND OPENS IT. INSIDE IS THE CORPSE OF A GOLDEN SKELETON.

USING SOME WATER FROM WHAT LITTLE RESERVES SHE HAS LEFT, SHE POURS A DROP ON THE SKELETON’S CORPSE.

MARIE: [marie2]'PLEASE GOD OF JUSTICE… HELP ME…'
[slow]THE TOMB BEGINS RUMBLING...[wait:1.5] [norm]AND WHAT ECHOES THROUGHOUT IS THE MANIACAL LAUGHTER OF THE ANCIENT FIGURE OF LEGEND AS HE RISES FROM HIS SLUMBER:

game_start: WELCOME TO [gold]GOLDEN BAT[reset]. EXPLORE THE RUINS OF ATLANTIS, FIND AND COLLECT 7 RELICS, AND DEFEAT THE MYSTERIOUS DR. NAZŌ...

beats.text: YOU ENTER AND FACE DR. NAZŌ WITH THE FULL MIGHT OF ATLANTIS.
GOLDEN BAT UNWRAPS THE BOTAN RICE CANDY AND EATS IT, GIVING HIM A BURST OF NOSTALGIC ENERGY, WHILE THE 7 RELICS GLOW WITH BLINDING LIGHT!
GOLDEN BAT DOESN'T JUST DEFEAT FIVE FINGER AND DR. NAZŌ — HE TRANSFORMS INTO A GIANT GOLDEN SILHOUETTE, OVERTAKING THE COSMOS AND SHATTERING THE PLANET ICARUS WITH A SINGLE HEROIC STRIKE.
[gold][slow]GOLDEN BAT: 'HA-HA-HA-HA-HA-HAAA...!!!'[norm]

endings.message: You are a master of Atlantis.

beats.text: DR. NAZŌ STANDS IN THE MIDDLE OF THE ROOM, FACING AWAY FROM YOU, OVER AN ANCIENT SPECTRAL CANNON...
DR. NAZŌ: 'So you've collected all the relics, Golden Bat? And retrieved the Icarus Data? Regardless, I have the special lens, and you will never destroy Icarus!'
[gold]GOLDEN BAT: 'HA-HA-HA-HAAAA!'
DR. NAZŌ: 'What's so funny, you fool?'
GOLDEN BAT USES HIS SPECTRAL REINS AND GRAPPLES ON FIVE FINGER, SLASHING IT WITH A SINGLE DOWNWARD STRIKE WITH HIS SILVER BATON. GOLDEN BAT SNATCHES THE SPECIAL LENS FROM DR. NAZŌ.
FIVE FINGER CRUMBLES UNDER ITS OWN WEIGHT AND BURSTS INTO FLAMES, AND BEGINS DIGGING VIOLENTLY INTO THE GROUND.
DR. NAZŌ: 'CURSE YOU, GOLDEN BAT! I WILL RETURN!'
THE MACHINE DISAPPEARS TUNNELING UNDERNEATH ATLANTIS, AND THE ISLAND BEGINS RUMBLING.
GOLDEN BAT RUSHES BACK TO THE SHIPWRECKED BEACH TO SEE MARIE. THE HERO FINDS MARIE, AND HANDS HER THE SPECIAL LENS AND ICARUS DATA.
JUST THEN, THE FLYING SUPER CAR APPEARS ON THE BEACH INSTANTANEOUSLY DRIVEN BY JAPANESE INVENTOR, PROFESSOR YAMATONE OF THE PEARL RESEARCH INSTITUTE.
PROF. YAMATONE: 'Quickly, Marie! Come with me back to the Pearl Research Institute, before you meet the same fate as your father! With that lens and data, we can save the world!'
MARIE: 'Thank you, Golden Bat!'
PROF. YAMATONE: 'This is no time for solemn goodbyes!'
MARIE ENTERS THE SUPER CAR AND DISAPPEARS WITH PROFESSOR YAMATONE ALMOST AS FAST AS IT ARRIVED, LEAVING GOLDEN BAT BEHIND ON THE BEACH.
THE LOST ISLAND BEGINS SINKING UNDERWATER, WITH THE LINGERING LAUGHTER OF THE GOD OF JUSTICE...
[gold][laugh][slow]GOLDEN BAT: 'HA-HA-HA-HA-HA-HAAA...!!!'[norm]

endings.message: Earth is saved from the rogue planet Icarus.

beats.text: THE HALL APPEARS EMPTY, WITH AN ANCIENT SPECTRAL CANNON IN THE MIDDLE OF THE ROOM...
DR. NAZŌ: 'Golden Bat! Did you really think you could defeat me without all the relics?'
FIVE FINGER DESCENDS FROM THE CEILING, AND CAPTURES GOLDEN BAT IN ITS METALLIC GRIP.
DR. NAZŌ: 'There is nothing you can do to stop me! I will destroy Earth!'

endings.message: Dr. Nazō has captured Golden Bat and Icarus impacts Earth.
